about_the_game:
Remnants of Corruption will take place inside the Skada Tower, a dark corrupt place. Once you step inside, your only way out will be surviving the countless challenges the tower conceals.

Corruption mechanic

Every time you complete a room, corruption will rise. Whenever you are greedy and want juicer rewards, corruption will rise. The motto of this tower is that corruption rises whatever you do. And when corruption rises, the tower also morphs, and everything will become more challenging.

However…

Rewards at the start of each room

Every time you enter a room the tower will grant you new upgrades, so you can build yourself up and be a worthy opponent.

Doors – choose your path

Each time you survive a room, you will be able to choose between two (or more?) doors. These doors will grant you a specific reward (hearts, gold, weapons…) once you complete the upcoming room. That way you will be able to choose your path and build yourself up.

Deities

You will be gifted by a deity of your choice to improve your runs substantially. Let’s say you choose Sol, the fire deity. This means, the probability of fire relics will drastically increase, so synergies will be more available.

Your deity will also perform a variety of attacks that will get stronger and stronger as you level up both during the run and outside as your raise your affinity level with them.

New character: Lili

Lili will devour all the darkness around her and morph into more terrifying and lethal forms!!

She will introduce Dark Hearts and hex-related relics such as her adorable Laser Plushie or minion Tentacles that will make her life much easier clearing the room.

And more…

 

  • New relics

  • Skada Tower Metaprogress

  • Original Soundtrack

name: Nordic Ashes: Remnants of Corruption
short_description: Conquer the heights of the Skada Tower and face multiple challenges in each room. The further you go, the more corruption you will find in your path. At the end of each chamber, choose your path by walking through different reward doors to build yourself up!
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Korean, French, Italian, Polish, Ukrainian, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Swedish, Czech, Traditional Chinese
